1.o: In 1940, the U.S. had yet to enter WW II when controversial comic artists Joe Simon and Jack Kirby created a new Marvel hero to take on Hitler. On his first cover, Captain America punches Hitler, making a patriotic statement and enraging the Nazis.

2.o: In a time when the DC-Marvel rivalry made crossovers all but impossible, three friends go rogue. Inspired by a Halloween parade, Marvel and DC artists intertwine heroes and story lines for the first real crossover, and execs are none the wiser.

3.o: In 1970, after DC successfully poaches longtime Marvel comic artist, Jack Kirby, Stan Lee learns his old pal has been harboring resentment when Kirby’s comic villain “The Funky Flashman” looks remarkably familiar, forever altering their relationship.

4.o: When two Marvel creators publish a Dr. Strange story with religious overtones, Stan Lee fears it'll upset readers and pushes them to write a retraction. Instead, they hatch a scheme to keep the storyline and avoid any future creative scrutiny.

5.o: The first official Marvel-DC crossover was far from a simple collaboration for the famous rivals. Before the Man of Steel and Spidey could share that bone-crushing handshake, Stan Lee and Carmine Infantino had to battle it out behind-the-scenes.

6.o: DC implements a bold initiative in the mid 70s to combat plummeting sales by launching the “DC Explosion” to bring more titles to newsstands. But a miserably cold winter Affects sales and DC is forced to cancel 40% of their line.

7.o: In the late 80s Batman’s new sidekick, Jason Todd, was less than a hit with fans. DC decided to let its audience choose his fate. Comic readers could call in and vote for the life or death of young Robin -- and their choice shook the comic world.

8.o: When frustrated comic book writers at DC are forced to shelve a storyline a year in-the-making, they do the unthinkable, and kill Superman. What started as an off-handed remark turned into a worldwide phenomenon and jump-started a lagging DC Comics.

9.o: Trying to compete with Marvel, DC attempts to create a worldwide sensation. It should have been a blockbuster series over a few issues, but instead turned into a legendary three-year boondoggle known as "The Clone Saga" that fans lament to this day.

10.o: Stan Lee, the pioneer of Marvel, shocks the comic book industry when he announces he’s going to work for DC. Teaming up with various DC in-house creators, Stan re-imagines some of the company's most well-known, iconic characters.

1.o: Ten young Hampton locals gear up for the most exciting summer of their lives. But everything changes when a newcomer arrives from the city to shake things up and they realize that their Hamptons bubble is about to burst.

2.t: The Summer With Stars, Stripes, and Chicken Fights
2.o: It’s Fourth of July in the Hamptons and the crew gets together at Ilan’s for a party. Drama ensues as Hunter confronts Ilan, Reid tries to clear the air with Milo, and a chicken fight reveals someone’s true colors.

3.o: The morning after Ilan’s party brings more than just trash to clean up. Frankie tries to make things right with Reid and Milo, while Juliet and Habs use the situation to discuss their similar experiences growing up in the Hamptons. And as Ilan juggles two dates in one week, Avery works on building new friendships, and Emelye finds solace in the ones she already has.

4.t: The Summer With a Side of Beef
4.o: Reid throws a party to try and bring people together, only to have everything fall apart. An Instagram post reveals to Emelye just how much she’s being excluded, Habs goes on a date with an old friend, and Ilan learns that sometimes honesty is the best policy.

5.o: Lottie throws a boat party, and the common denominator of the summer drama becomes clear. Meanwhile, Emelye’s sister questions the validity of her life goals, and Avery tests the waters of her relationship with Frankie. A new Dockers employee joins the team, and Ilan’s mom gives him advice, but mother can’t always be right.

6.t: The Summer With Exes and O's
6.o: Emelye plans to throw a White Party but Hunter might RSVP “no” once he finds out who’s invited. Sophia keeps Ilan in the friendzone, while someone else’s ex may cause a budding relationship to wilt. And after Reid apologizes to Avery, will it be enough to fix their fractured friendship? Or will Avery be heading back to school with one less friend than before?

7.t: The Summer With the Jealous Boyfriend
7.o: Avery hosts a black tie event, and Lottie's boyfriend causes things to get heated. A first kiss takes Ilan’s relationship to a new level, while Juliet struggles with her family’s rejection of her boyfriend, Tony. Frankie wonders whether he’s going to be part of Avery's post-summer plans.

8.o: Summer is coming to a close, and everyone has loose ends to tie up. Shannon and Milo try to get to the bottom of Todd’s jealousy, while Ilan wonders if a long-distance relationship is in the cards for him and Sophia. And as Habs leaves for his freshman year, Juliet plans a future with Tony with or without her father’s blessing.

2.o: Erin convinces her older self to try to help her and the Girls find a way home to 1988…right as they are stalked by Prioress, one of the evil Old Watch soldiers determined to erase them from history.

1.o: Rikka, Chiyo, Sekine and Tsubasa seem like regular middle-school girls, but they all have their own secrets.

2.o: Chiyo, despite her normally calm demeanor, is easily worked up. Cute things make her pull all-nighters to pursue cuteness. Ninja-related things remind her of her ninja upbringing.

3.o: When visiting a local street food vendor who just can't read the room, Rikka is forced to reveal several new powers that are only mildly threatening to the entire human race.

4.o: If you could make a wish come true, what would it be? Change the past? Change your gender? Lose weight? Whatever it is, Colonel Rikka has you covered. She just won't warn you beforehand.

5.o: After some ups and downs during the final exams, it's off to summer vacation at the beach. Great weather, great food, and great excuses for excessive self-defense await!

6.o: Sekine invites Chiyo to a sleepover at her house, and the other two invite themselves as well. They deepen their bond while Rikka learns more about the quirky cultural activities that take place on Earth.

7.t: Ring Out! The Songs of Friends
7.o: What was supposed to be a fun visit to the karaoke studio suddenly turns into an emergency when the four friends are abducted by a shadowy organization.

8.o: Hanzo, the assassin sent against Chiyo by her former ninja clan, cannot defeat Chiyo in single combat. He decides to cleverly attack Chiyo through her friends, Chiyo's only apparent weakness.

9.o: Fuku-chan, Rikka's new space alien pet, has gone missing, and he's not just a harmless walking giant mushroom. Can Sekine stop him from devouring her friends, both figuratively and literally?

10.o: The four friends go on a trip to Atami, a resort area known for its hot springs and traditional wooden dolls. However, it also featured an eagle-eyed local who could accurately determine Tsubasa's gender.

11.o: Time is running out. The lies are not holding. When the truths comes out, can the four kids remain friends? Can Rikka stay on Earth, without messing with the space-time continuum?

1.o: Journey down the East Australian Current all the way from the Great Barrier Reef to Antarctica. Discover how ocean currents create life on our planet and what you can do to protect our planet's blue heart.

2.o: Ride the East Australian Current through the subtropical marine environments of New South Wales with a pod of migrating humpback whales, we explore how the warm flow sustains and transforms whole ecosystems.

3.o: As we reach the end of the East Australian Current, its remaining flow mixes into the Antarctic Circumpolar Current and the Indian Ocean. Our whales finally leave Tasmania's temperate waters on their journey to Antarctica.

1.t: Nine Dozen Heroes and One Wicked Man
1.o: The Emperor dispatches his favourite, wicked Kao Chiu, to the sacred mountain to exorcise the evil behind the terrible plague that grips China. Kao Chiu discovers an ancient temple, its doors sealed shut on the orders of a previous emperor. Within is a pit believed to contain the souls of nine dozen rebellious knights. The souls are scattered over China, now reborn as heroes who will take a stand against the corruption that has gripped the empire. One such hero might be Lin Chung, an honourable officer in the imperial army. However, Kao Chiu hatches a plot to have Lin Chung discharged from the

2.o: Lin Chung accepts his punishment, continuing his journey to Tsang Chou jail. On the way he encounters a band of rebel outlaws who try to persuade him to join them. Lin Chung refuses. fearing for the safety of his wife, Hsiao Lan, still in the capital city - and under the lustful gaze of Kao Chiu. Once imprisoned, Lin Chung earns the respect of head guard Lu Ta. However, Kao Chiu still plots against Lin Chung from a distance - and his evil desire for Hsiao Lan grows all the time.

3.t: Both at Last Will Reach the Sea
3.o: Yang Chih - known as 'Blue Face' - is one of the few honourable men in government. Kao Chiu has banished him to a distant province - with orders to capture and kill Lin Chung. Lin Chung, searching for his wife Hsiao Lan, is offered refuge by Wang Lun, leader of the rebel warriors of Liang Shan Po. However, Yang Chih has captured Lin Chung's wife: Lin Chung must face Yang Chih in a duel that will decide the fate of them all.

4.t: Ever Busy are the Gods of Love
4.o: With Lin Chung now at Liang Shan Po, the union of the rebel knights has begun. Hearing the news, 'Tiger Hunter' Wu Sung heads for the water margins. Shih Chin - 'Tattooed Dragon' - has already joined the mountain bandits led by Chu Wu, but in pursuit of his true love he is captured and faces certain death.   Now Lin Chung must unite with Wu Sung and Chu Wu to execute the daring rescue of Shih Chin.

5.t: A Treasure of Gold and Jade
5.o: Evil Kao Chiu, not content with being Viceroy and head of the army, plots with his brother-in-law to become Prime Minister as well. Yang Chih -'Blue Face' - is given a chance to redeem himself after his earlier failure: he must guard the tax collections destined for Kao Chiu. The good rebels of Liang Shan Po soon learn that a huge fortune of jade and gold is on the move - as does the respected nobleman Chao Kai. With Chao Kai ride Hu San-Niang and Lu Ta, the former head guard of Tsang Chou jail. Lin Chung is on a collision course with Chao Kai - and Yang Chih.

6.o: Kao Chiu, desperate to retrieve the stolen treasure, dispatches his forces to all corners of the empire. He discovers that Lin Chung has joined the bandits of Liang Shan Po, and that Chao Kai was involved in the theft. Wang Lun, the leader of the rebels, hears that Chao Kai has been arrested, and sends Lin Chung to rescue both the fortune and the nobleman. Kao Chiu lures Wang Lun into a trap which will deliver the defences of Liang Shan Po, the outlaws, and the treasure, into his hands.

7.t: How Easy to Die, How Hard to Live
7.o: Kao Chiu is sent the head of Wang Lun. Furious, and suspicious of the good judge Sung Chiang, Kao Chiu orders him to investigate Yen Po-Hsi, Wang Lung's former lover. Working for Kao Chiu, Yen Po-Hsi seduces Sung Chiang. stealing vital information regarding Liang Shan Po. The judge is forced to kill the girl, then flees, seeking refuge with Lord Chai Chin and his mighty servant, Li Kwei, the Black Whirl-wind'. However, only Lin Chung's intervention at the battle of the Shallow River of the Dead can now save the judge.

8.o: Sung Chiang, not yet ready to join the bandits of Liang Shan Po, seeks the counsel of his friend Hua Yung, prefect of Ching Feng. Knowing of Hua Yung's fairness, Kao Chiu has appointed an additional, corrupt prefect. The new prefect's wife, Hsiu Lan, has been captured by bandits. Shih Chin - 'Tattooed Dragon' - has joined the group of outlaws, who also capture Sung Chiang. Shih Chin persuades the bandits to release their captives. However, Hsiu Lan tells her husband that Sung Chiang and Shih Chin were her captors, Lin Chung must now rescue them both, bringing them to the justice and honour of

9.t: A Dutiful Son and the Love of a Brother
9.o: Kao Chiu fumes, seemingly unable to destroy his enemy, Lin Chung. However, Kao Chiu's arm is long, and his cunning boundless. Newly appointed and ambitious, Huang Wen-Ping has a plan of his own. He will capture the good judge Sung Chiang and thus lure Lin Chung from the safety of the water margins of Liang Shan Po. Sentenced to Chiang Chow jail, Sung Chiang must now keep his wits about him.

10.o: Tortured and beaten, Sung Chiang faces execution at the hands of evil Huang Wen-Ping. As Tai Sung hurries to Liang Shan Po with the news, Wu Sung - the 'Tiger Hunter' - arrives at Chiang Chow jail, intent on freeing Sung Chiang himself. However, Wu Sung is captured, and Liang Shan Po's plan for rescue is intrinsically flawed. As Lin Chung and the other rebels approach the jail, Kao Chiu is waiting for them.

11.t: The Girl Who Loved the Flower Priest

Lu Ta, the 'Flower Priest', encounters Yang Chih - 'Blue Face' - who is roaming the area in disgrace. Lu Ta's heart hangs heavy for the 'songbird' held captive by the bandits. Once enemies, Lu Ta and the honourable 'Blue Face' plan to overthrow the

12.o: Kao Chiu's obsession with the destruction of Lin Chung and the outlaws of Liang Shan Po continues to grow. An investigation into the supporters of the rebels reveals Hua Yung as a major conspirator. In hiding at a water circus, Hua Yung is travelling to the safety of Liang Shan Po. Kao Chiu questions Hua Yung's brother-in-law: if he does not hand over Hua Yung, his entire family will be killed.

13.t: When Liang Shan Po Robbed the Poor
13.o: Kao Chiu, consumed by greed, is now plotting to overthrow Prime Minister Chi Ching. Kao accuses the Prime Minister of being lax in collecting taxes, and allies himself with Lord Chu and his three warrior sons. Together they raid several of the tax collections en route to the capital, ensuring that they leave Liang Shan Po's flag. With the good rebels of the water margin implicated, Lin Chung must investigate - and Kao's minions will be waiting.

2.o: بعدما اكتشف "ساتورو" مقتل أمه بطريقة وحشية في شقته، يعود بالزمن 18 عامًا إلى الوراء قبل اختطاف ومقتل "كايو"، زميلته في الصف.

3.o: فيما يعيش "ساتورو" من جديد أيام طفولته المدرسية، يتعرّف على "كايو" ويبقى بجانبها يوم الأول من مارس لإحباط محاولة الاختطاف التي أودت بحياتها.

4.o: بينما تساوره الشكوك في بقاء "كايو" على قيد الحياة، يعود "ساتورو" المضطرب فجأة إلى الحاضر، حيث تبحث عنه الشرطة كمشتبه به في جريمة قتل أمه.

5.o: يقابل "ساتورو" "ساوادا"، زميل أمه السابق، والذي يبحث أيضًا عن علاقة بين مقتلها وعمليات الاختطاف التي وقعت في الماضي.

6.o: تعرض "كايو" على أصدقائها الحقيبة التي خبأها الغريب الغاضب في الحافلة، وتأخذ أمه ومعلمه خطوة لمساعدة "كايو" بعدما استمدت الإلهام من "ساتورو".

7.o: يكافح "ساتورو" وزملاء الصف في مصادقة تلميذ وحيد من مدرسة ابتدائية أخرى خوفًا من أن يصبح الهدف التالي للمُختطِف.

8.o: يطارد "ساتورو" الخاطف المزعوم بمساعده من معلّمه. وبعد سنوات، يوافق زميل الصف السابق "كينيا" على مساعدة "ساوادا" في إيجاد المجرم الحقيقي.

9.o: يستيقظ "ساتورو" مدركًا أنه لا يتذكر الماضي ولا قدرته، ولكن بمساعدة زملاء الصف السابقين، يجمع شتات ماضيه المنسي.

5.o: Otis admits to stealing grapes but denies the extortion; suddenly, August realizes that Bridgette might in fact be the extortionist after all; Vanessa reveals more to Bridgette about their family, and Dana learns something shocking about Rose.

6.o: The Kings’ wine business has brought the family success and acclaim, but following the patriarch’s sudden exit from the company, his three children must grapple for the reins to the kingdom: to their own power, wealth and legacy.

1.t: But I Just Took an Ambien
1.o: عقب رفضها في برنامجها الصيفي، تكتشف "آني جايكوبسون" أنها وشقيقها التوأم "كونور" قد ورثا "نقطة سترلينغ"، وهي جزيرة صغيرة في منطقة "موسكوكا" في "كندا". بينما تدفع رسالة غامضة من الجد الذي لم يُسمح لها بلقائه قط "آني" إلى خوض رحلة سرية بمفردها، آملة في كشف حقيقة تاريخ عائلتها.

2.o: يأخذ وصول "آني" إلى "موسكوكا" منعطفاً مفاجئاً عندما تجد الكوخ الذي ورثته مأهولاً بالفعل من قبل "رامونا". وهي فتاة غريبة تشبه والدتها بالتبني بشكل كبير. بينما تصطدم علاقتهما المتعثرة بعقبة أخرى بسبب رسالة من "غوردون" إلى "رامونا"، تشير إلى رابط مدفون بينهما، مما يجبر الفتاتين على مواجهة ماض مشترك لم تكن أي منهما تعلم بوجوده.

3.o: بينما تتصادم "آني" و"رامونا"، يساهم شريط أغاني وحفلة كوخ متهورة، وقبلة غير متوقعة في تبديد الجفاء. إلى أن يصل "كونور" حاملاً مفاجأةً مدوية قد تعصف بكل شيء.

4.o: في محاولة يائسة لإقناع "كونور" بعدم بيع "نقطة سترلينغ"، تقضي "آني" اليوم في إطلاعه على سحر الجزيرة، لكن تصل التوترات إلى ذروتها خلال ليلة فوضوية أثناء عرض فيلم في الهواء الطلق. وتدخل "رامونا" في حالة تخبط بسبب علاقة "أونا" العاطفية الجديدة. يتنافس "إيليس" و"روري" لجذب انتباه "آني"، بينما تظهر حقائق جديدة بشأن ولادة "رامونا" ووفاة "غولدي".

5.t: I'm Not a Shots Girl Either
5.o: إنه عيد الميلاد الـ18 لـ"آني" و"كونور". وكلاهما يمر بمرحلة تخبّط في اتجاهين متعاكسين، إذ يقيم "كونور" لنفسه حفلة عيد ميلاد كبيرة، بينما يقرر "روري" اصطحاب "آني" للخروج مع أصدقاء قدامى. وفي هذه الأثناء، بعد معرفة "رامونا" الحقيقة بشأن وفاة والدتها، تمارس عادتها المعهودة، التهرّب. لكن عندما تظهر "ميبل" منهارة، تفصح "رامونا" أخيراً عن مشاعرها.

6.t: I Still Bleed Through My Pants All the Time
6.ar: ما زلت أنزف وألوث ملابسي طوال الوقت
6.o: يعود "ستيفن" العاجز عن الهروب من ماضيه إلى "موسكوكا" آملاً في إصلاح العلاقات المدمرة وإعادة "آني" و"كونور" إلى المنزل. وفي هذه الأثناء، تتوجه "آني" و"رامونا" و"أونا" و"إيليس" و"كونور" إلى مخيم "ميبل" لدعمها في عرضها الكبير، بينما تدخل "رامونا" و"أونا" في مرحلة شديدة الرومنسية. لكن تدفع حقيقة صادمة "رامونا" إلى دوامة من التخبط، مهددة التوازن الهش للمجموعة.

7.o: مع تصاعد التوترات بشأن البيع المحتمل لـ"نقطة سترلينغ"، تصارع "رامونا" قرارها بالبيع، بينما تكافح "آني" و"إيليس" و"أونا" و"سالي" لإقناعها. وعندما يتصادم ماضي "رامونا" ومستقبلها، تواجه علاقاتها مع الأشخاص الذين يريدون التحكم في مصيرها، مما يؤدّي إلى اكتشافات غير متوقعة ومواجهات عاطفية وتحول مفاجئ يقلب الموازين.

8.o: تواجه "آني" و"رامونا" حقائق قاسية عن عائلتيهما ونفسيهما، مما يجبرهما على تحديد الأولويات الحقيقية وسط التجاذب بين خيارات الماضي وآمال المستقبل.
